english.note: Use this for a porch understood specifically as a covered architectural entrance or veranda rather than just the entrance area.

examples.english: This house’s porch has a tiled roof, so we don’t have to worry when it rains.
examples.traditional: 呢間屋嘅門廊有瓦頂，落雨都唔怕。
